from fastapi import APIRouter

from app.db import save_order

orders_router = APIRouter()


@orders_router.post("/orders")
async def create_order(payload: dict):
    order_id = await save_order(customer=payload["customer"], items=payload["items"])
    return {"id": order_id}

from fastapi import APIRouter
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from app.db import save_order

orders_router = APIRouter()


class OrderIn(BaseModel):
    customer: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=120)
    items: list[int] = Field(min_length=1, max_length=50)


@orders_router.post("/orders")
async def create_order(payload: OrderIn):
    order_id = await save_order(customer=payload.customer, items=payload.items)
    return {"id": order_id}

import requests
from fastapi import APIRouter

rates_router = APIRouter()

RATES_URL = "https://rates.example.com/latest"


@rates_router.get("/rates/{currency}")
async def get_rate(currency: str):
    response = requests.get(RATES_URL, params={"base": currency}, timeout=10)
    response.raise_for_status()
    return {"currency": currency, "rate": response.json()["rate"]}
